technical.summary: Strong bullish technicals with multiple MA confirmations and MACD crossover, but overbought RSI(9), weak ADX trend strength, and OBV divergence suggest caution on new entries; better suited for existing longs or pullback entries.

fundamental.summary: NOC shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 28 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 buy vs 1 sale, small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.28), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 28 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical setup with MACD crossover, price above major MAs, supertrend bullish, and 15x volume spike combined with extreme fear sentiment (17/100) creates classic contrarian buy opportunity in oversold market conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI(9) at 72.8, weak ADX trend confirmation, OBV divergence, absent fundamental catalysts, earnings risk in 28 days, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, USD headwind) make this a high-risk entry with limited upside room and pullback probability.
